note: Derived scalars emitted so the report cites numbers a pipeline step produced, never numbers a person typed. NUMBER leaves only — no interpreted prose.

falseAlarmAccounting.status: NOMINAL ACCOUNTING under the stated approximations — NOT an upper bound and NOT a calibrated rate

arms.name: pairwiseJoint-upper
arms.screen: jointPValue < α/24 (already Bonferroni-corrected across the 300 within-config pairs)

arms.name: cherryPickSurvival
arms.screen: cherryPickSurvivalP < 0.01 (Step 17, one arm over the whole seed set)

arms.name: convergence-5SE
arms.screen: |wins/n − p| > 5·√(p(1−p)/n) at each checkpoint of the ladder

notAnUpperBound.what: the nominal normal-tail level of the 5·SE screen is BELOW its exact binomial rejection probability, so the nominal levels summed above are not upper bounds on the screens they describe
notAnUpperBound.method: exact integer arithmetic over C(n,w)·(25−m)^w·m^(n−w) / 25^n, rejection set replayed from the implemented floating-point predicate

validBounds.method: Bernstein's inequality for a sum of n i.i.d. Bernoulli(p) indicators, evaluated at the implemented 5·SE boundary
validBounds.note: arms 1–7 (chi-square, pairwise-joint, serial lag-1, runs, cherry-pick survival) have no valid upper bound in this package, so the TOTAL above stays nominal
